Daily Work Log — vistributions

Source: daily-log.md

Project: vistributions (R & Python)
Maintainer: Aravind Hebbali (rsquaredacademy)
Current Branch: develop
Current Phase: Phase 0 (Hygiene, Bug Remediation & v0.2.1 Patch Release)

1. Active Focus & Sprint Status

  • Sprint Goal: Complete Phase 0 deliverables — resolve all 12 identified bugs, clean up repository hygiene debt, correct pedagogical errors in vignettes, modernize community health files, and prepare CRAN v0.2.1 submission.
  • Current Status: In Progress (Planning complete; implementation of Phase 0 underway).

2. Daily Log Entries

2026-09-08

Completed Today

  • Codebase Technical Audit:
    • Conducted line-by-line review of all 11 R source files in R/ (~2,235 lines), all 6 test files in tests/testthat/, CI workflows in .github/, man pages, and the primary vignette.
    • Identified 12 confirmed bugs (including critical x-axis scaling errors, truncation in F percentiles, crash on negative percentiles in t distribution, and validation bypasses).
    • Quantified ~54% copy-paste code duplication across vdist-plots.R and vdist-data-prep.R.
    • Identified the “CRAN Blindspot” (zero value-based tests; 100% of plotting tests skipped on CRAN via vdiffr::skip_on_cran()).
    • Uncovered 5 pedagogical and numerical contradictions in vignettes/introduction-to-vistributions.Rmd.
  • Roadmap & Architecture Documentation:
    • Created roadmap/roadmap.md: Full strategic plan, competitive analysis (R, Python, Web/Mobile), and 7-phase roadmap.
    • Created roadmap/product_requirements_document.md: User personas, functional requirements (FR-1 to FR-8), NFRs, and 24-month KPIs.
    • Created roadmap/technical_design_document.md: Unified registry engine architecture, adaptive boundary algorithm, bug fix technical specifications, and Python port architecture.
    • Created roadmap/implementation_plan.md: 24-month WBS spanning Phases 0 through 6, milestone schedule, and risk management.
    • Created roadmap/test_plan.md: Value-based testing pivot (10−810^{-8} tolerance), bug regression test matrix, trimmed visual snapshots, and bilingual test vectors.
  • Configuration & Build Hygiene:
    • Updated .gitignore and .Rbuildignore to ignore the roadmap/ directory.
  • GitHub Milestone & Issue Backlog Setup:
    • Created GitHub Milestone #3: Phase 0: Hygiene, Correctness & CRAN Patch (v0.2.1) (Due: 2026-10-31).
    • Populated milestone with 17 tracked issues (#44–#60) across hygiene, 12 bug fixes, refactoring, docs, community health, and CRAN prep.
